title: Portable design-system contract
summary: Keep machine-readable tokens and human-readable design rationale together so agents can apply a brand consistently across sessions and stacks.
when_to_use: Several pages or agents must preserve one product identity over time.
avoid_when: The user asked for a one-off sketch with no established brand decisions.

anatomy.purpose: Names the audience, tone and non-negotiable visual decisions.
Defines colors, typography, spacing, radius and component defaults in parseable form.
Explains why each decision exists and where exceptions are allowed.
Records good and bad examples without copying third-party imagery.

tokens.name: colors.primary
tokens.purpose: Primary semantic color, referenced by components.

tokens.name: typography.body
tokens.purpose: Body type role with family, size, line height and weight.

responsive: Specify typography and spacing behavior at key container sizes, not only one desktop screenshot.
accessibility: Validate the contrast of token combinations used for text and controls.
Specify accessible alternatives when brand colors fail contrast.
implementation_steps: Interview the user about existing visual identity and product constraints.
Record canonical tokens separately from descriptive prose.
Translate token roles into the project's CSS variables, theme object or native equivalents.
Review one implemented page against the contract and update the contract when decisions change.
